resources.string: Automatic calibration
Manual calibration
Nudge brightness calibration

Identify the native System UI brightness control. Measure 17 positions during calibration. Optional slider touch completion presses and releases supported sliders to save their values. Enable this service from Automatic calibration in Nudge. It reads controls only during calibration. It does not take screenshots or record the screen.
Nudge measures 17 positions on the native brightness slider. You may need to open Control center yourself. Your screen will become dim and bright.
Android grants this separate service access to window content. Nudge uses it only for System UI brightness controls during calibration.

Nudge does not take screenshots, record the screen, or read notification text. Measurements stay on this device. Optional slider touch completion briefly touches only the identified native brightness slider during calibration.
Slider touch completion
Allow slider touch
Allow brief touches on supported native brightness sliders to save each measured position. Keep your hands off the screen during calibration.

Some Xiaomi sliders save brightness only after a touch release. Allow Nudge to briefly press and release the identified brightness slider during automatic calibration? This permission applies only to the separate calibration service. It does not enable screenshots or touch actions in the normal handle service.
This native slider needs a touch release to save brightness. Enable Slider touch completion. If it is already on, disable and re-enable the calibration service in Accessibility.
Nudge restores your brightness and automatic mode before showing results. You choose whether to save the measurements.
Enable Nudge brightness calibration in Accessibility. Return to Home and select Start calibration.
Enable calibration service
Allow brightness access
Start calibration
Select Start calibration. Then open Control center and keep the brightness slider visible. Measurement starts when Nudge finds the control.
Keep the brightness slider visible. If notifications open, open Control center from the top right. In the old style, expand quick settings. Nudge waits up to 30 seconds.
Opening Control center…
Calibrating brightness: %1$d%%
Cancel automatic calibration
17 positions were measured. Your original brightness and mode were restored. Save this calibration for this device?
Automatic calibration saved. The temporary accessibility service is off.
Automatic calibration saved. The calibration service remains enabled and idle.
Keep calibration service enabled
Keep this service on between runs. It reads controls only during calibration. Use Disable calibration service when you finish.
Disable calibration service
The calibration service is enabled and idle. Select Automatic calibration to start another run.
Cannot save the calibration service option. Try again.
Calibration cancelled. Your saved calibration was kept.
Calibration was interrupted or brightness could not be restored. Restore the saved brightness and mode, or keep your current brightness.
Restore previous brightness
Keep current brightness
Unlock your phone and keep the screen on during calibration.
Calibration setup timed out. Start Automatic calibration again when you are ready.
Cannot find or adjust the native brightness slider. Keep it visible in Control center, or use Manual calibration. If this repeats, select Copy compatibility details in Info.
The brightness control changed or the screen rotated. Start again with Control center available.
The brightness readings did not settle. Use Manual calibration or try again.
The measurements were not valid. Use Manual calibration.
Cannot restore brightness. Allow brightness access, then select Restore previous brightness.
Cannot save calibration. Try Save again.
The calibration service stopped. Start Automatic calibration again, or use Manual calibration.
Cannot open Accessibility settings. Open Android Settings and enable Nudge brightness calibration.
